description: Use when the user asks which firms can audit or certify them (SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, PCI DSS, HITRUST, FedRAMP, CMMC C3PAO), by country or US state, or whether a firm is accredited. Returns Verified and registry-listed firms, labelled by listing tier. Not a ranking or endorsement.

accreditation_body.description: Accreditation body, e.g. ANAB, UKAS, PCI SSC QSA, CERT-In

country.description: Headquarters or office country (US, United Kingdom, India, …)

framework.description: Framework tag, e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, CERT-In

list.description: Dated snapshot id: soc2-audit-firms, anab-iso-27001, or fedramp-3pao-soc2. Returns that list. Each row uses the same verified flag as other registry snapshots (false when the row is not a Verified listing). Not a ranking.

query.description: Free-text query over firm name, headquarters, frameworks and accreditation bodies

name: search_auditors
title: Search compliance audit firms
